thread:
maya: Heads-up  Nebulon Labs says they were double-charged for November Dedicated usage. Invoice INV-9921 shows two identical line items for "Dedicated Reserved Capacity" totaling $24,000. Can we audit and fix?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice INV-9921 (2025-11-20) attached. Line items include Dedicated Reserved Capacity x2.
support: I pulled the provisioning logs. Two allocation jobs ran because a prior pricing-experiment feature retried the initial reservation on 2025-11-01 and created a duplicate reserve id. Customer terminated the duplicate on 2025-11-04 via support ticket #55999.
sam: Do we have correlation id for the duplicate reserve? Need it for audit and to explain to customer.
support: Duplicate reserve id: res-dup-77a9. Original reserve id: res-11f3. Both billed. Evidence: provisioning logs + ticket thread.
leo: Quick math: single monthly reserved capacity = $12,000. Invoice shows $24,000. Refund should be $12,000 minus any prorate if they used the duplicate for a few days. According to usage, duplicate was active 3 days (11/01-11/04). Proration: (12,000 / 30) * 3 = $1,200. So net refundable = $10,800.
maya: Suggestion: issue customer credit of $10,800, mark reason = "system-duplication-pricing-experiment", and flag internal experiment for rollback. Also add $500 goodwill credit for disruption? Thoughts?
sam: +1 to the $10.8k refund. The $500 goodwill falls under ops discretion; if approved it should be Promo-7505.
gina: I approve the $10,800 refund and the additional $500 goodwill. Approved total credit = $11,300. Use GL: AR-Adj-6200, Promo-7505. Tag cost center: COGS-Reserved. Approving as VP Finance.
billing-bot: [automated] Created adjustment ADJ-4999. Credits queued: $11,300. Attachment: INV-9921-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-4999 / AR-6200 / PROMO-7505.
maya: I'll send the external note. Draft below  feel free to edit: "Hi Nebulon team  thanks for flagging. We found a duplicate reserving job from an internal pricing experiment that caused the second charge. We've applied a $11,300 credit to your account and republished your invoice (INV-9921-v2). Expect the credit to reflect on your next statement. We're disabling the experiment and will follow up with a short RCA. Apologies for the disruption.  - Maya, Finance Ops"
sam: Add a line about whom they can contact for faster reconciliation (sam@redwood.com).
maya: Sent. Customer replied: "Thanks for the fast fix and transparency. Appreciate the goodwill." Closing ticket #55999.
leo: Filing an internal incident for the pricing-experiment rollback and next steps. Tagging eng-experiments and devex.
maya: Noted. Closing this thread.
